summary: Vista Energy, S.A.B. de C.V. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its main subsidiary Vista Energy Argentina S.A.U. priced U.S.$400,000,000 of 7.875% senior notes due 2038 at an issue price of 99.473%, a 7.950% yield to average life, expected to close October 9, 2026. The notes are additional notes fungible with the existing U.S.$500,000,000 2038 series, bringing total outstanding to U.S.$900,000,000, governed by New York law, sold under Rule 144A and Regulation S. Principal amortizes 33%/33%/34% on April 8, 2036, 2037 and 2038. This is a routine debt capital markets issuance, not a special situation.
